Introduction

SeoAh is a South Korean singer under MODHAUS.

SeoAh was introduced as the twenty-third member of the girl group tripleS on April 3, 2024. She debuted with tripleS on May 8, 2024, with the album "ASSEMBLE24".

As a member of tripleS, SeoAh was placed in the sub-units Glow and Neptune.
